title: When Should AI Agents Ask? Clarification Requests Under Limited Human Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.41129v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents increasingly carry out delegated tasks in parallel, with one person overseeing several of them at once. In practice, an agent often lacks information its task requires, such as an unstated preference, constraint, or specification. It can ask the human to clarify, or it can search for the information itself, for example in past records, which takes time and effort and may fail. In this paper, we study how to coordinate these decisions across several agents that share one human with limited attention. We build a stylized model in which each agent can search, ask, or continue the parts of its task that do not depend on the missing information, and we formulate the problem as a dynamic program. translated_title: AI智能体何时该提问？人类注意力有限下的澄清请求
translated_abstract: AI智能体越来越多地并行执行被委托的任务，一个人需要同时监督多个智能体。在实践中，智能体常常缺乏完成任务所需的信息，例如未明确说明的偏好、约束或规格。它可以请人类进行澄清，也可以自行搜索信息，例如在过往记录中查找，但这需要时间和精力，且可能失败。本文研究了如何在共享一位注意力有限的人类的多个智能体之间协调这些决策。我们构建了一个风格化模型，其中每个智能体可以选择搜索、提问，或继续执行任务中不依赖缺失信息的部分，并将该问题形式化为动态规划问题。我们首先证明，智能体是否应该提问并不仅仅取决于其自身的不确定性：拥有其他工作可做的智能体反而更适合提早提问，而人类应该优先回答哪个问题，则取决于所有处于等待状态的问题……
tldr: 本文研究了多个AI智能体共享一位注意力有限的人类时，如何协调“提问澄清”与“自行搜索信息”之间的决策，发现提问时机与人类应优先回答的问题取决于全局等待情况，而非单个智能体自身的不确定性。
en_tdlr: This paper studies how multiple AI agents sharing one human with limited attention should coordinate decisions between asking clarification questions and searching for information themselves, showing that the timing of questions and which question the human should answer first depend on the global set of pending questions rather than any single agent's own uncertainty.
